Subject: Pricing follow-up: token volumes, unit economics & finance intro

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for taking the call today — really enjoyed learning more about Acme AI's roadmap for customer-facing summarization and support bots. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

1) Traffic & intent (what we agreed on)
- Peak prompt+completion tokens: ~1.2k tokens per request average
- Estimated steady-state: 12M-18M tokens/month for Q4 pilot; potential scale to 40M+/month next year depending on adoption

2) Pricing & unit economics (goal from your team)
- You mentioned a target unit cost in the range of $700-1,000 per 1M tokens for pilot sizing
- We'll model both hosted and dedicated scenarios; attached is a working pricing calculator (Redwood_pricing_calc.xlsx) and my discovery notes (20260721-discovery-notes.pdf)

3) Ask: confirm economic buyer & finance sign-off path
- Could you please confirm who will own budget approval for this pilot? On other deals we typically route the final pricing approvals through finance + the economic buyer (VP/Head of Product or Finance). If it helps, we can do a short 30-min pricing review with your finance/econ buyer to walk through unit economics and discount thresholds.

Proposed next step: Intro/meeting with the budget owner + Naomi (our finance lead) and Aditya (SE) — 30 minutes next week to validate numbers and discuss any procurement requirements. Available windows: Wed 7/28 10:00-11:00 PT, Thu 7/29 14:00-15:00 PT.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a calendar invite once you confirm best time and owner to include.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0134

Thanks Marissa — great summary and really appreciate the clear next steps. A few quick notes from our side: 

- Volume confirmation: 12M-18M/month for the pilot is correct. We may be conservative at first, but we want to size for ~15M to be safe.
- Target unit economics: Priya (cc'd) is aiming for $800-950 per 1M tokens for the pilot. If we can show clear cost predictability and a good SLA, she'll be much more comfortable.
- Budget owner / econ buyer: Priya Shah (VP Finance) will own budget approval. I'll ask her to confirm whether we need a formal procurement P.O. or if a purchase order after finance sign-off is fine.

Wed 7/28 10:00 PT works for me. Priya — can you confirm availability?

-Jordan
